summary: Balance of Power: where each candle closed relative to its open, scaled by its range, from -1 to +1.
overview: Balance of Power (BOP) shows who controlled each bar. Values near +1 mean buyers pushed price from open to high; values near -1 mean sellers pushed it from open to low.
It plots in its own pane around zero, green above and red below. You can turn on smoothing for a calmer line.
how: BOP = (close - open) / (high - low). A bar with no range gives zero.
With Smoothing on, the raw value is passed through a simple moving average of the chosen length (14 by default).
use: Some traders watch the smoothed line crossing zero as a change in who controls the bars.
Use long runs above or below zero to see steady buying or selling.
Compare BOP with price to see if a new high is made with weaker bars.
Turn smoothing off to inspect single candles.
alerts: Alerts: you can alert on its line crossing a value or the candle close (from the chart's + menu); checked while ZoroCharts is open.
notes: Works on any symbol and timeframe; it only needs candle data.
The raw form is noisy; most readers use the smoothed line.
